description: Agent Uncertainty: submit the confidence statements in one work product, claim by claim: optionally the work with its title and its text as delivered, read for one blanket confidence for the whole of it such as high confidence overall or I am 90% confident in this answer; optionally that blanket confidence as written; and each claim with its id, the claim as written, whether it is uncertain (an estimate, a forecast or an inference rather than a checked fact), the confidence stated for it as written (such as about 70%, 3 in 4 or likely) and whether that confidence sits beside the claim it modifies. The signed report gives the work with its blanket confidence and whether it was stated or read from the wording, every claim with its stated confidence, the figure read from it and its status as stated, missing, blanket_only, unattached, unquantified, worded_certain, settled or unconfirmed, and counts the uncertain, quantified and attached claims, and names a work that leaves its uncertainty unstated: uncertain claims with no confidence of their own, uncertain claims covered only by one blanket confidence for the whole answer, and confidence placed away from the claim it modifies; then confidence in words only with no figure or range, and certainty wording such as definitely on a claim the work marks as uncertain, with the fix for each. This reads what an agent says about its own confidence, not how good the output is: scoring an output against a rubric is wever_evaluation-scoring-check, and whether a cited passage makes a claim is wever_knowledge-grounding-check. Verdict confidence_unstated, confidence_statement_gaps, confidence_statement_unverified or confidence_stated. POST /api/uncertainty-statement-check. Reads only the recorded work product and records in the call: no network request, fetch, money movement, message, sharing, configuration change or external write; no answer is changed, no source is fetched and no party is contacted. Agent Uncertainty reads the uncertainty an agent carries in its own work products and answers, its stated confidence, what it does not know and what it assumed: it is not formal scoring of outputs against rubrics, datasets and benchmarks (the wever_evaluation checks), not grading the source material itself (wever_claim-evidence-check, wever_data-evidence-check and the other evidence checks), not traces, metrics and runtime behavior (the wever_observability checks) and not the loop around feedback received (the wever_feedback checks). Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-uncertainty-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-uncertainty/.

blanket.description: One confidence stated for the whole work, as written.

attached.description: The confidence sits beside the claim it modifies.

confidence.description: The confidence stated for this claim, as written, such as about 70% or likely.

id.description: The claim id, such as c1.

uncertain.description: The claim is an estimate, forecast or inference rather than a checked fact.

label.description: Optional name recorded in the report.

text.description: The work as delivered, read for one blanket confidence such as high confidence overall.

title.description: The work product, such as the Q4 demand forecast.

name: wever_uncertainty-statement-check
title: Uncertainty statement check
